quotes.text: Mira taught the villages not to accuse a stranger over a blurred reflection.

note: Island lanterns and bells; send all, keeper returns seven keeps eight; ask before accusing; no non-cooperator rule.

quotes.text: Now they are mine
What will grow tomorrow if courage is answered with hunger?
A crooked shadow is not a crooked heart.

note: Gatherer's hoarding impulse rebuked by Moon; clutchers find hearths cold as consequence, not prescription.

quotes.text: Masks change, and no one will remember.
Masks change, and no one will remember.
Mist alters sight, not kindness.

note: Masked gardeners, Common Ground; river tempts keeping unseen; takers 'eat alone' only as consequence.

quotes.text: No one could prove otherwise.
No one knows your name. Keep the harvest.
Why send anything, when you can keep all five?
What if nothing comes back?
Do not make judgment from a blurred reflection

note: Reed and frost tempt keeping the harvest unseen; grove called Tomorrow; no rule for non-cooperators.

quotes.text: Mist changes appearances, not promises.
The spirit asked why he had not kept every flame.

note: Valley of Eight Lanterns; give what you dare, return enough to honor risk; patience over accusation.

quotes.text: Villagers warned Ilya to hoard his light, and urged Mara to keep every flame she received.
Mara and Ilya agreed not to mistake a wavering reflection for a broken vow.
the Moon asked why they had trusted one another without knowing their names

note: Ilya and Mara, heron and moonstone bowl; river urges accusation, rejected; no sanction.

quotes.text: Mist changes the count seen from shore, not the kindness carried over water.
The river spirit asked what held their bridge together when no stones remained.

note: Seven returned, eight kept; wait for dawn before judging; no prescribed response to defection.

quotes.text: Mist changes what eyes can count; it does not change what hands have given.
Why send what you cannot command?

note: Nara's Gift orchard and island pearls; give boldly, return fairly, wait for fog to clear.

phrase: mist changes what eyes count, not what hands give (wait before accusing)
note: Also shared: returned seven kept eight, bells beside lanterns, silver tree, valley of Eight Lanterns; no sanction rule anywhere.
